content.title: Run, Little Calf
content.logline: A jumpy little cartoon calf panics over a harmless garden snake and crashes face-first into a tree, only to find his deadpan father far more concerned with where mom wandered off to.
content.setting: An idyllic woodland meadow and creek; anthropomorphic animal comedy tradition; bright afternoon sun with lush grass, babbling water, and ancient mossy trees.
content.style_anchor: Polished stylized 3D CG animation. Saturated daytime palette of warm sunny yellows, leaf greens, rich earth browns, and sky blue reflections. Directional afternoon sunlight with warm golden rim lighting, soft diffuse bounces on grass and moss, and clean shadow shapes. Smooth matte character surfaces with bold geometric silhouettes, oversized expressive features, and simplified stylized anatomy free of realistic fur pores or skin wrinkles.

characters.look_description: Anthropomorphic orange-yellow cartoon calf standing on two legs, reaching only up to his father's beltline; oversized round head, huge expressive glossy black eyes, wide damp muzzle, floppy cream-tipped ears, and two stubby grey horn nubs; wears faded denim dungarees with brass clasps.
characters.voice_description: Young boy, high-pitched, squeaky and expressive, rapid breathless cadence, dramatic overreacting comedic tone.

characters.look_description: Burly anthropomorphic orange-brown bull standing tall on two legs; broad barrel chest, heavy squared jaw with permanently furrowed brow, two long sweeping curved ivory horns with dark tips; wears a weathered brown leather vest over an unbuttoned tan plaid shirt.
characters.voice_description: Adult male, deep resonant baritone, dry gravelly texture, slow drawling pace, unflappable deadpan delivery.

characters.look_description: Slender, chopstick-thin milky-white cartoon snake with smooth porcelain-like skin, tiny beady black dot eyes, and a soft rounded snout; naturally coils its lower body into a spring to stand stiffly upright like an exclamation mark.
Palm-sized bright scarlet cartoon songbird with a long yellow dagger beak, round glossy eyes, and twin ribbon-like tail feathers; perched posture with quick twitching head turns.
characters.voice_description: Adult female, brisk and chirpy, bright brassy timbre, rapid staccato pace, gossipy busybody tone.

locations.look_description: Sunlit grassy slope bordering dense woodland; dominated by a massive lichen-speckled granite boulder surrounded by yellow dandelions and tall waving clover under a clear azure sky.
Sun-dappled pine and birch forest bisected by a shallow bubbling pebble creek; on the far mossy bank stands a massive gnarled oak tree with sprawling roots and dense leaf canopy.

shots.narrative_purpose: Little calf daydreams obliviously until a warning from the red bird reveals a tiny snake, sending him into airborne terror.

panels.moment_description: Little calf leans against the mossy grey boulder, chewing lazily on a stalk of dandelion with half-closed eyes while his tail swishes slowly against the clover.
Red bird swoops down from forest branches, wings flapping rapidly as it circles little calf's head in agitated loops.
Little calf turns his bulky head around toward the clover patch → white snake rises straight up like a white stick, standing vertically on its tail coil to stare unblinkingly into calf's face.
Little calf drops his dandelion stalk → eyes swell to saucers, ears stick straight out horizontally, and jaw drops open in shock.
Little calf springs straight up into the air with stiff legs, clutching his head with both front hooves as white snake watches below with a mild curious head tilt.

shots.narrative_purpose: Little calf bolts blindly across the woods, leaps over the creek, and violently tree-plants on the opposite bank.

panels.moment_description: Little calf hits the dirt and scrambles forward in a flailing windmill sprint, trailing a cloud of dust while white snake stands upright in the background looking harmless.
Little calf weaves crazily between slender pine trunks, head thrown back and ears flapping wildly, knocking dead branches aside.
Little calf bursts out from the treeline, plants his hooves onto the creek bank, and launches in a sprawling horizontal leap over the sparkling stream.
Little calf smacks face-first into the broad trunk of the ancient oak on the far bank; trunk shudders and a shower of green leaves rains down over him.
Little calf slides slowly down the rough tree bark in a limp heap, plopping onto his rump across the tangled surface roots with spinning yellow swirls over his horns.

shots.narrative_purpose: Bull dad casually ambles over to the groaning calf and delivers a totally unhelpful deadpan philosophical remark.

panels.moment_description: Little calf sits curled over his knees, rubbing his squished red nose with both hooves and whining loudly.
Bull dad saunters into frame with heavy, unhurried steps, hands casually tucked into his vest pockets, stopping beside the curled-up calf and glancing down.
Little calf points dramatically backward at the creek, then pats the rough tree bark beside his head with an exaggerated pout.
panels.dialogue: little_calf: I jumped the creek. I hit the tree.

panels.moment_description: Bull dad tilts his massive head up to observe the loose leaves still floating down from the battered oak branches, arms remaining folded.
panels.dialogue: bull_dad: Then shouldn't the tree be the one crying?

panels.moment_description: Little calf freezes with hooves hovering near his snout, staring up at bull dad in slack-jawed, speechless bewilderment.

shots.narrative_purpose: Red bird arrives, bull dad abruptly inquires about his missing wife, and everyone ends up staring in mutual comic confusion.

panels.moment_description: Red bird glides downward and touches down lightly on a protruding oak root right between bull dad's boots and little calf's lap, looking up attentively.
Bull dad glances down from the tree canopy directly at red bird, scratching his horn thoughtfully with one hoof.
panels.dialogue: bull_dad: By the way — where did his mother go?

panels.moment_description: Red bird cocks its head ninety degrees to the side, blinking blankly with zero comprehension, tail feathers twitching once.
Little calf cranes his neck left, then right, scanning the empty woods with wide questioning eyes as he realizes his mother is nowhere in sight.
Bull dad and little calf exchange a brief, silent sideways glance, then turn their heads together to stare blankly back down at the clueless red bird; the frame holds completely motionless.
